proofs.name: TestSmolvmEndToEnd
proofs.proves: one job from offer to report in a real smolvm machine, against the fake control plane

proofs.name: TestSmolvmEgressEndToEnd
proofs.proves: a smolvm machine reaches its declared host, is refused an undeclared one and a declared name that answers a private address, by name and by address, with the refusals recorded
proofs.command: go test -count=1 -run '^$' ./internal/daemon/ && WORKER_DAEMON_SMOLVM_NO_SKIP=1 WORKER_DAEMON_E2E_PACK="$LIVE_PROOF_BASE_PACK" WORKER_DAEMON_E2E_ALLOWED=api.github.com PRIVATE_LOCAL=1 UPSTREAM="$(awk '/^nameserver/ {print $2; exit}' /etc/resolv.conf)" internal/daemon/testdata/private-name-netns.sh private-name.e2e.test 10.255.0.1
